name: Lynchian Device
type_description: Thomas Henry 8038-based sine oscillator with twin-peak waveform
bom_parts_summary: 8038 oscillator IC, DG271 analog switch, TL072 x3, TL074, 2N3906 transistors, 1N4148, VTL5c vactrol
components_evidence: BOM lists ICs (8038, DG271, TL072, TL074) as DIP, transistors (2N3906) as TO-92, and all resistors/capacitors as through-hole; no SMD parts named anywhere in the BOM.

lineage.credit: A classic Thomas Henry 8038-based sine oscillator with a twist.
lineage.quote: A classic Thomas Henry 8038-based sine oscillator with a twist.

notes: Page states no HP and no license. Module name is a homage to David Lynch (naming only, not a design credit) - not treated as lineage. Schematic PDF has no text layer, so components were judged from the on-page BOM table only.
